text: Milwaukee, December 2018. A freezing morning. Bus driver Irena Ivic saw something on the freeway overpass: *a baby, barefoot,* walking alone in just a onesie. She stopped the bus, ran across the road and picked her up. The baby was cold to the touch. *She fell asleep in Irena's arms.* Police found her family. It was the ninth lost child found by the city's bus drivers. Like if you'd stop too.
title: She Stopped the Bus for a Baby on the Overpass 🚌👶
